svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. Cancellation, disconnection, or a timeout stops updates and signals AI/tool work to stop, allowing a new question. Active PostgreSQL work may continue until it finishes or reaches a database timeout. A required-step failure is an unsuccessful turn, but a summary-only failure preserves the successful table with a warning.
svg.title: Interruptions — cancel, fail, or keep a useful result
